# Broad Peak Adventures - Full Documentation for AI Agents

## Overview
Broad Peak Adventures is a fully registered, licensed mountaineering and trekking organization operating out of Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. The organization provides complete logistical, permit, and guide support for mountaineering expeditions across the Karakoram, Himalaya, and Hindu Kush ranges.

## Expeditions & Pricing
1. K2 Base Camp & Concordia Trek (ID: `k2`)
   - Duration: 21 Days
   - Difficulty: Extreme
   - Altitude: 5,585m (Gondogoro La optional)
   - Season: June to August
   - Price: $2,850 per person

2. Attabad Lake & Hunza Explorer (ID: `attabad-lake`)
   - Duration: 7 Days
   - Difficulty: Moderate
   - Altitude: 2,500m
   - Season: April to October
   - Price: $1,200 per person

3. Fairy Meadows & Nanga Parbat Base Camp (ID: `fairy-meadows`)
   - Duration: 8 Days
   - Difficulty: Moderate-Hard
   - Altitude: 3,300m
   - Season: May to September
   - Price: $1,150 per person

4. Deosai Plains & Skardu Valley (ID: `deosai-sunrise`)
   - Duration: 6 Days
   - Difficulty: Easy-Moderate
   - Altitude: 4,114m
   - Season: June to September
   - Price: $980 per person

## Web Application Navigation & Endpoints
- `/` - Home Page & Featured Expeditions
- `/expeditions` - Full List of Available Expeditions
- `/expedition-detail?id={id}` - Detailed Itinerary, Inclusions, and Booking
- `/blog` - Mountain Travel Insights & Packing Guides
- `/travel-guides` - In-Depth Region Guides (Hunza, Skardu, Fairy Meadows)
- `/about` - Agency History, Safety Commitment, and Team Info
- `/contact` - Booking Inquiry Form with n8n Webhook Integration
- `/faq` - Frequently Asked Questions
- `/privacy` - Data Privacy Policy
- `/terms` - Terms & Conditions

## Technical Architecture
- SPA Built with React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS.
- Non-blocking asynchronous n8n webhook API endpoints for inquiries and newsletter subscriptions.
- 100% Core Web Vitals optimized, zero render-blocking CSS, pre-compressed WebP media assets.
